card.name: Just before words of exclusion or impossibility
card.fires_on: Words right before an expected term of opposition, ruling out, or impossibility, such as 'preclude', 'impossible', 'opposed', 'contraindication' or 'abhorrence'. It fires on the small word or noun that sets up that term.

modes.description: A word or word start just before a term meaning ruling out or barring, in medical text.

modes.label: Setup for opposition or aversion
modes.description: A word before a term of opposition, dislike or toxicity.
modes.example: Stalin advocates a concept that<< communism>> until now has bitterly opposed.

card.writes: It pushes toward words meaning oppose, forbid, inhibit or reject, such as 反对, 禁止 and prohibited.
card.plain: It fires just before a phrase that says something is ruled out, forbidden, opposed or impossible.
